<b>{{PAGENAME}}s</b> are a crafting material, made from smelting [[iron ingot]]s in the [[furnace]] with [[graphite]], or alternatively may be purchased from the [[Blacksmith]]. Steel is used primarily for high-tier equipment, as well as for making [[steel parts]] which are necessary for some of the late-game content.
